name: dev.auth4.sdk
description: Game authentication for auth4.dev: device login, guest sessions with safe upgrades by email or social providers (in the system browser, or a popup in WebGL builds), adding, changing or removing a verified email address on a signed-in account, and rotating refresh tokens kept in memory unless a secure storage adapter is supplied.

samples.description: A scene with device login, guest play, saving guest progress and sign-out using in-memory tokens.
